goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules.
acceptance_criteria: The tool scans a directory for .png and .jpg files recursively.
It uses pytesseract (mocked in tests) to extract text and applies regex to find vendor, date, and amount.
It outputs a CSV file with extracted data.
It handles invalid files gracefully (skips non-image files).
